m1 - IMPLEMENTED, NOT COMMITTED, AND HELD FOR A RULING. The change works and has a second effect the ruling did not anticipate.

DONE: dEnt returns Estimate.missing(AllMissing) on empty specified participants, Estimate.observed otherwise, formula untouched per requirement 2. Entity moved from the always-present terms to the optional ones. Entity added to MayBeMissing, and deliberately NOT to HasReductionReceipt - like Sensory it has no chart source, which is the split the chief introduced in ee258bf.

RESULT: align 188 of 192. Two pinned literals moved as expected. TWO BEHAVIOURAL ASSERTIONS ALSO FAILED, which is the part that needs a ruling:

  WorkedExampleSuite: "Stephen King goes to the Association external state, not to a source node"
    -> that unit now carries 0.2562 source mass
  WorkedExampleSuite: "support density: an external unit is light"
  chronology  0.039516 -> 0.104070
  specificity 0.678220 -> 0.659371

THE MECHANISM, and it is why d_ent is not the same as d_sens. blend skips absent terms entirely:
CostTerm.values.flatMap(t => terms.get(t).map(weights(t) * _)).sum. So

  d_sens imputed 0.0 -> contributed 0 -> making it Missing removed a zero -> NO cost change.
  d_ent imputed 0.5 at weight 0.4 -> contributed 0.2 -> making it Missing REMOVES A 0.2 PENALTY
  from every cell of every participant-less unit.

Recording absence has therefore ALSO removed a penalty, for exactly the units the term could not evaluate. Participant-less units are now cheaper to anchor everywhere. FOR A TERM WHOSE IMPUTED VALUE WAS NONZERO, RECORDING ABSENCE IS ITSELF A RETUNE - which is what requirement 2 was written to prevent, arrived at by a route the requirement did not cover.

Options put to the chief (msg-01M177NDKG8S0EJBFXABAEHQVP): (a) accept the behaviour and update expectations plus golden; (b) renormalise the blend over present terms so absence is not a discount - bigger, touches every absent term including the ones just ruled; (c) revert, on the grounds that the cure moves alignment more than the disease. My lean is (a) and I have not chosen.

Holding rv-01M177G58CDSA5B6ZR9G2MBC9D on cost.scala and wire.scala until ruled, or will release if someone else should take it.
